description: Package versions that entered the tree inside the 7-day maturity buffer, reviewed 7 and 14 days after publication (advisories, upstream issues, release notes), and dated milestones that ride the same list. Milestones are UTC dates derived from `published`. A review is recorded under `reviews.<milestone>` as { date, outcome: clean | flagged, note }, dated the day it is written and never later; one written up to 2 days before its milestone also carries early: { reason }, and the entry's later milestone stays due. A package entry leaves the list in the change that records its clean 14-day review; a date entry stays, with its `due` review recorded as the evidence that the day was reviewed; a package entry whose version leaves the tree before that review leaves the list too, because nothing is left to review. Read by scripts/testing/maturity-watchlist.mjs (--check in CI, --remind in the maturity-reminder workflow).
